notes.content: I have fixed some music volume levels not working correctly. Fixed an issue in the caves where you move an object the player gets stuck on the object. Now player does not get stuck. Added a new teleport back to entrance option on certain caves and dungeons.
Fixed a music track and a battle speed bug

notes.title: 1.3 Battle Animations fixed and The battles will also move faster
notes.content: I fixed the battle Animations to where they are faster and I also made the battle twice as fast.
Fixed monster encounters being to often

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content: Just fixed some music in the game that was left out by mistake.

notes.title: Besotted is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I’m excited to announce that Besotted is now available for purchase, and you can get it with a 10% discount! 🎉

If you experience any issues with the game, like bugs or crashes, please leave a comment below, and I’ll make sure to fix them as soon as possible. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Steam Deck
notes.content: I have some exciting news regarding the upcoming release! I've been playing the full game on the Steam Deck, and everything works perfectly right out of the box. While it hasn't been officially verified by Valve yet, rest assured that if you own a Steam Deck, it will run smoothly. I'll be working closely with Valve to get it officially verified soon.
